# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository uses Engineering Mastery Workflow (EMW). Follow the root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and consult [.emw/core/](../.emw/core/) for detailed operating rules.

For meaningful tasks, inspect before editing, select an appropriate EMW collaboration mode, plan before implementation, verify changes, and keep engineering delivery separate from developer mastery. Do not infer mastery from AI-generated code or claim checks passed unless they were actually run. Treat authorization, multi-tenancy, payments, secrets, privacy and destructive operations as high risk requiring human review.

See [the any-agent guide](../docs/USING-WITH-ANY-AGENT.md) for bootstrap and task prompts.
